nodes.description: Token name string state variable.
Token symbol string state variable.
Token decimals state variable.
_totalSupply state variable holding the total token supply.
balances mapping of address to token balance.
allowed nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance.
Constructor that initializes name, symbol, decimals, total supply and mints tokens to msg.sender.
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply minus balances of address(0).
balanceOf(address) view returning the balance of tokenOwner.
allowance(address,address) view returning the remaining allowance.
approve(address,uint) writing the allowed mapping for msg.sender.
transfer(address,uint) moving balances from msg.sender to a recipient.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) moving balances and deducting allowance without an explicit allowance check.
SafeMath safeAdd helper performing checked addition.
SafeMath safeSub helper performing checked subtraction.
SafeMath safeMul helper performing checked multiplication.
SafeMath safeDiv helper performing checked division.
msg.sender used as the caller identity in constructor, approve, transfer and transferFrom.
safeSub applied to balances[msg.sender] inside transfer (arithmetic on balances).
safeAdd applied to balances[to] inside transfer (arithmetic on balances).
safeSub applied to balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
safeAdd applied to balances[to] inside transferFrom.
transferFrom deducts from the allowed mapping using safeSub instead of an explicit require on allowance, allowing any caller to spend an approved allowance path.

tokens parameter of approve.
to parameter of transfer.

from parameter of transferFrom.

tokens parameter of transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf.

tokenOwner parameter of allowance.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the name state variable.

Constructor sets _totalSupply to the initial supply.
msg.sender is read in the constructor to mint the initial supply.
_totalSupply is assigned to balances[msg.sender].
Constructor writes the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value in approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
to parameter is the recipient in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount transferred in transfer.
msg.sender is the sender in transfer.
transfer invokes safeSub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer invokes safeAdd on balances[to].
tokens parameter is the subtrahend in the transfer safeSub call.
tokens parameter is the addend in the transfer safeAdd call.
msg.sender index selects the balance operated on in transfer.
safeSub result is written back to balances[msg.sender].
safeAdd result is written back to balances[to].
The updated sender balance order precedes the recipient balance update in transfer.

from parameter is the balance owner in transferFrom.
to parameter is the recipient in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the spender in transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom invokes safeAdd on balances[to].
tokens parameter is the subtrahend in the transferFrom safeSub calls.
tokens parameter is the addend in the transferFrom safeAdd call.
msg.sender indexes allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.

safeSub result is written back to balances[from].
safeSub result is written back to allowed[from][msg.sender].
safeAdd result is written back to balances[to].

transferFrom relies on safeSub reverting instead of an explicit allowance requirement check.
